title: Hammer with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='44' y='45' width='12' height='48' rx='5' fill='#c97b3a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='45' width='5' height='48' rx='3' fill='#e09a55'/>
  <!-- handle bottom cap -->
  <rect x='42' y='88' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#a55e22'/>
  <!-- hammer head -->
  <rect x='12' y='18' width='76' height='30' rx='8' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <!-- hammer head top highlight -->
  <rect x='16' y='21' width='68' height='8' rx='4' fill='#b8cbdd'/>
  <!-- hammer head left face -->
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='33' rx='7' ry='15' fill='#7a8fa5'/>
  <!-- hammer head right face -->
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='33' rx='7' ry='15' fill='#a2b6ca'/>
  <!-- cheek left -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='38' r='4' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <!-- cheek right -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='38' r='4' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <!-- eye left -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='30' r='4.5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='28.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- eye right -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='30' r='4.5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='28.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 39 Q50 48 60 39' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- small shine on head -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='24' rx='6' ry='2.5' fill='#e3eef7' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
